result.instructions: Tools for Together AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Together AI data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run together_ai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run together_ai_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run together_ai_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. together_ai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: together_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Identify the API key: its organization, project and project slug. The project slug forms the `<project_slug>/<endpoint_slug>` model name for dedicated-endpoint inference. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Together: GET /whoami.

tools.name: together_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List Together's models with type (chat, language, code, image, embedding, moderation, rerank), context length, organization, license and per-token pricing. Together: GET /models.

dedicated.description: Only return models that can run on dedicated endpoints.

tools.name: together_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List uploaded data files (fine-tune, eval and batch-api inputs, plus job outputs) with size, type, purpose and validation status. Together: GET /files.

tools.name: together_get_file
tools.title: Get one file
tools.description: Fetch one file's metadata, including its processing_status and validation_report (why a fine-tune training file was rejected). Together: GET /files/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_fine_tunes
tools.title: List fine-tuning jobs
tools.description: List fine-tuning jobs with status, base model, output model name and training settings. Together: GET /fine-tunes.

tools.name: together_get_fine_tune
tools.title: Get one fine-tuning job
tools.description: Fetch one fine-tuning job: status, progress, hyperparameters, token counts, cost and the output model name. Together: GET /fine-tunes/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_fine_tune_events
tools.title: List a fine-tuning job's events
tools.description: List the event log of one fine-tuning job (queued, started, checkpoint saved, epoch completed, errors). The first place to look when a job failed. Together: GET /fine-tunes/{id}/events.

tools.name: together_list_batches
tools.title: List batch jobs
tools.description: List batch inference jobs with status, progress, model and input/output/error file ids. Together: GET /batches.

tools.name: together_get_batch
tools.title: Get one batch job
tools.description: Fetch one batch job: status (VALIDATING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED), progress, and the output_file_id / error_file_id once done. Together: GET /batches/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints
tools.description: List endpoints with model, owner and state (PENDING, STARTING, STARTED, STOPPING, STOPPED, ERROR). Use mine=true and type=dedicated to see what is running on your account and billing by the minute. Together: GET /endpoints.

mine.description: Only endpoints owned by the caller.

tools.name: together_get_endpoint
tools.title: Get one endpoint
tools.description: Fetch one dedicated endpoint: state, model, hardware, autoscaling bounds and display name. Together: GET /endpoints/{endpointId}.

tools.name: together_list_hardware
tools.title: List hardware
tools.description: List hardware configurations for dedicated endpoints with GPU type/count/memory and price in cents per minute. Pass a model to get only compatible configurations with live availability. Together: GET /hardware.

model.description: Only hardware compatible with this model, with availability.

tools.name: together_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluation jobs
tools.description: List LLM-as-a-judge evaluation jobs (classify, score, compare) with status, parameters and results once completed. Together: GET /evaluation.

status.description: Filter by status: pending, queued, running, completed, error, user_error.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

tools.name: together_chat_completion
tools.title: Chat completion
tools.description: Run a chat completion on a Together model (billed per token). Non-streaming. For a dedicated endpoint pass its `<project_slug>/<endpoint_slug>` as the model. Together: POST /chat/completions.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for reasoning models that support it.

tools.name: together_create_embeddings
tools.title: Create embeddings
tools.description: Generate vector embeddings for one or more texts (billed per token). Together: POST /embeddings.

input.description: A text, or a list of texts, to embed.

tools.name: together_generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image
tools.description: Generate images from a prompt (billed per image/megapixel). Returns image URLs by default rather than base64, to keep responses small. Together: POST /images/generations.

guidance_scale.description: Prompt adherence; higher is more literal.

image_url.description: Input image URL, for models that support editing.

response_format.description: url (default here) or base64. base64 can be very large.

tools.name: together_create_fine_tune
tools.title: Create a fine-tuning job
tools.description: Start a fine-tuning job on an uploaded training file (billed per token processed). Stop it with together_cancel_fine_tune. Together: POST /fine-tunes.

training_file.description: File id of an uploaded training file (purpose fine-tune).

validation_file.description: File id of an uploaded validation file.

suffix.description: Suffix for the fine-tuned model's name (max 64 chars).

n_evals.description: Evaluations on the validation set during training.

from_checkpoint.description: Continue from a previous job: <job_id>, <output_model_name>, optionally with :<step>.

training_type.description: Full fine-tune or LoRA. Together defaults to LoRA when omitted.

lora_r.description: Rank of the LoRA adapter matrices.

lora_alpha.description: Scaling factor applied to the LoRA adapter weights.

lora_trainable_modules.description: Comma-separated target modules, or all-linear for the model defaults.

training_method.description: Supervised fine-tuning (sft, the default) or preference tuning (dpo).

train_on_inputs.description: Whether prompt/user tokens contribute to the loss; 'auto' lets Together decide.

tools.name: together_cancel_fine_tune
tools.title: Cancel a fine-tuning job
tools.description: Cancel a running fine-tuning job. Cannot be resumed, but a new job can continue from its last checkpoint via from_checkpoint. Together: POST /fine-tunes/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: together_create_batch
tools.title: Create a batch job
tools.description: Start an asynchronous batch job over an uploaded JSONL input file (purpose batch-api), at a discount to real-time inference. Together: POST /batches.

input_file_id.description: File id of the uploaded JSONL request file.

endpoint.description: The API each line of the input file is sent to.

model_id.description: Model to process the requests with.

tools.name: together_cancel_batch
tools.title: Cancel a batch job
tools.description: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Together: POST /batches/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: together_create_endpoint
tools.title: Create a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Deploy a model on dedicated GPUs. The endpoint STARTS AUTOMATICALLY and bills per minute of uptime until stopped — set inactive_timeout to auto-stop it, and use together_list_hardware for valid hardware ids. Together: POST /endpoints.

min_replicas.description: Replicas kept running even with no load.

max_replicas.description: Maximum replicas to scale up to under load.

inactive_timeout.description: Minutes of inactivity before auto-stop; 0 disables it.

state.description: Initial state. Pass STOPPED to create without starting (and without billing).

tools.name: together_start_endpoint
tools.title: Start a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Start a stopped dedicated endpoint. It bills per minute of uptime until stopped. Reversible with together_stop_endpoint. Together: PATCH /endpoints/{endpointId} with state=STARTED.

tools.name: together_stop_endpoint
tools.title: Stop a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Stop a running dedicated endpoint, which stops its per-minute billing. Requests to it fail until it is started again. Together: PATCH /endpoints/{endpointId} with state=STOPPED.
